english: Tap the camera to scan your first document.
target: Toca la cámara para escanear tu primer documento.
backtrans: Tap the camera to scan your first document.

backtrans: There are no pages to show.

target: Aún no hay documentos en esta carpeta.

target: Este escaneo ya no está disponible.

target: No se pudo abrir el enlace.

target: Algo salió mal. Inténtalo de nuevo.
Guardado en el texto del documento

target: Esto deshace todos los filtros, rotaciones, recortes, cambios de tamaño y trazos de borrador en esta página.
backtrans: This undoes all filters, rotations, crops, size changes and eraser strokes on this page.

english: Front side captured. Now capture the back side.
target: Lado frontal capturado. Ahora captura el lado trasero.
backtrans: Front side captured. Now capture the back side.

target: PDF de tarjeta de identificación generado

english: Use your saved signature or draw a new one?
target: ¿Usar tu firma guardada o dibujar una nueva?
backtrans: Use your saved signature or draw a new one?

english: No documents to batch export. Scan some first.
target: No hay documentos para exportar por lotes. Escanea algunos primero.
backtrans: There are no documents to batch export. Scan some first.

english: No folders yet. Create one from the home screen.
target: Aún no hay carpetas. Crea una desde la pantalla de inicio.
backtrans: There are no folders yet. Create one from the home screen.

english: Copy text to clipboard after scan
target: Copiar texto al portapapeles tras escanear
backtrans: Copy text to the clipboard after scanning

target: Reproducir sonido al completar el escaneo
backtrans: Play sound when the scan is completed

target: Retroalimentación háptica al completar el escaneo
backtrans: Haptic feedback when the scan is completed

english: DOCX sources render poorly as pages — save inside the app is limited to JPG/PNG from image, PDF, TXT or CSV sources. Use Export & Share for this file.
target: Las fuentes DOCX se muestran mal como páginas; el guardado en la app se limita a JPG/PNG de imagen, PDF, TXT o CSV. Usa Exportar y compartir para este archivo.
backtrans: DOCX sources are displayed poorly as pages; saving in the app is limited to image JPG/PNG, PDF, TXT or CSV. Use Export and share for this file.

english: To save inside the app, choose JPG or PNG. Other targets are exported as files.
target: Para guardar en la app, elige JPG o PNG. Otros destinos se exportan como archivos.
backtrans: To save in the app, choose JPG or PNG. Other destinations are exported as files.

target: Exportación por lotes — colocación de firma deshabilitada

english: Tap a spot to sample its color
target: Toca un punto para muestrear su color
backtrans: Tap a point to sample its color

target: Error al generar PDF de identificación
OCR no disponible en este dispositivo.
backtrans: OCR not available on this device.

english: Your device doesn't support the advanced document scanner. Take a photo with your Camera app, then tap Import below to crop and save it.
target: Tu dispositivo no soporta el escáner avanzado de documentos. Toma una foto con la app Cámara y luego pulsa Importar abajo para recortarla y guardarla.
backtrans: Your device does not support the advanced document scanner. Take a photo with the Camera app and then press Import below to crop and save it.

target: Facturación no disponible — inténtalo más tarde.

english: No internet. Connect once to download the language pack.
target: Sin internet. Conéctate una vez para descargar el paquete de idioma.
backtrans: No internet. Connect once to download the language pack.

english: Language pack downloading or not ready. Try again shortly.
target: El paquete de idioma se está descargando o no está listo. Inténtalo en breve.
backtrans: The language pack is being downloaded or is not ready. Try shortly.

english: YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
target: TUS DOCUMENTOS SE QUEDAN EN TU DISPOSITIVO
backtrans: YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE

english: Your entire document office — scan, edit, sign, and export — in one private app.
target: Toda tu oficina de documentos — escanea, edita, firma y exporta — en una app privada.
backtrans: Your whole document office — scan, edit, sign and export — in one private app.

english: Annotate, sign, watermark, fill forms, seal, and more — every tool free and unlimited.
target: Anota, firma, añade marcas de agua, rellena formularios, sella y más — todo gratis e ilimitado.
backtrans: Annotate, sign, add watermarks, fill in forms, stamp and more — all free and unlimited.

english: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. OCR runs on your phone — nothing ever leaves your device.
target: Usa KatharScan en {count} idiomas. El OCR funciona en tu teléfono: nada sale de tu dispositivo.
backtrans: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. OCR works on your phone: nothing leaves your device.

english: E-sign contracts, type-to-fill forms, and stamp enterprise seals in seconds.
target: Firma contratos, llena formularios y estampa sellos en segundos.
backtrans: Sign contracts, fill in forms and stamp seals in seconds.

english: Every edit stays reversible — undo, redo, and revert to original anytime.
target: Cada edición es reversible — deshaz, rehaz y vuelve al original cuando quieras.
backtrans: Every edit is reversible — undo, redo and go back to the original whenever you want.

english: No account, no cloud, no watermarks. Your documents never leave your device.
target: Sin cuenta, sin nube, sin marcas de agua. Tus documentos nunca salen de tu dispositivo.
backtrans: No account, no cloud, no watermarks. Your documents never leave your device.

english: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase. All features remain free.
target: Apoya a KatharScan con una compra única. Todas las funciones siguen siendo gratuitas.
backtrans: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase. All features remain free.

target: Todas las funciones gratis para siempre

english: This is a non-consumable purchase. Restore it anytime on any device with the same store account.
target: Esta es una compra no consumible. Restáurala en cualquier momento en cualquier dispositivo con la misma cuenta de la tienda.
backtrans: This is a non-consumable purchase. Restore it at any time on any device with the same store account.

english: KatharScan ran into a problem displaying this screen. Your scans are safe — they're stored on this device and this doesn't affect them.
target: KatharScan tuvo un problema al mostrar esta pantalla. Tus escaneos están a salvo: se almacenan en este dispositivo y esto no les afecta.
backtrans: KatharScan had a problem displaying this screen. Your scans are safe: they are stored on this device and this does not affect them.

target: Ningún escaneo coincide con tu búsqueda.

english: No folders yet. Tap the folder icon to create one.
target: Aún no hay carpetas. Toca el icono de carpeta para crear una.
backtrans: There are no folders yet. Tap the folder icon to create one.

english: No favorites yet. Tap the star icon on a document to add it.
target: Aún no hay favoritos. Toca el icono de estrella en un documento para añadirlo.
backtrans: There are no favorites yet. Tap the star icon on a document to add it.

english: Share it with friends who need a powerful document scanner.
target: Compártelo con amigos que necesiten un potente escáner de documentos.
backtrans: Share it with friends who need a powerful document scanner.

english: Your feedback helps us grow and keeps the app free.
target: Tus comentarios nos ayudan a crecer y mantienen la app gratis.
backtrans: Your feedback helps us grow and keeps the app free.

target: Captura de ID por ambas caras: frontal + trasera
backtrans: ID capture of both sides: front + back

english: Welcome to KatharScan! This is the first public release featuring unlimited scanning, 29 languages, and export to PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG, and CSV.
target: ¡Bienvenido a KatharScan! Esta es la primera versión pública con escaneo ilimitado, 29 idiomas y exportación a PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG y CSV.
backtrans: Welcome to KatharScan! This is the first public version with unlimited scanning, 29 languages and export to PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG and CSV.

english: Allow background reminders for unexported documents
target: Permitir recordatorios en segundo plano para documentos no exportados
backtrans: Allow background reminders for unexported documents

english: Allow the app to occasionally ask for a rating
target: Permitir que la app pida una calificación ocasionalmente
backtrans: Allow the app to occasionally ask for a rating

english: Allow the app to occasionally suggest sharing
target: Permitir que la app sugiera compartir ocasionalmente
backtrans: Allow the app to occasionally suggest sharing

english: The pages could not be attached to the email. Use Share to send the pages.
target: No se pudieron adjuntar las páginas al correo. Usa Compartir para enviar las páginas.
backtrans: The pages could not be attached to the email. Use Share to send the pages.

english: This document has no text yet. Run OCR on it first.
target: Este documento aún no tiene texto. Ejecuta primero el OCR.
backtrans: This document does not have text yet. Run OCR first.

english: Your latest changes could not be saved.
target: No se pudieron guardar tus últimos cambios.
backtrans: Your latest changes could not be saved.

english: Tap the page where you want to type
target: Toca la página donde quieras escribir
backtrans: Tap the page where you want to type

english: This PDF has {count} pages. Pages that are pictures are read with OCR (about 10 seconds each); pages with real text are instant.
target: Este PDF tiene {count} páginas. Las páginas que son imágenes se leen con OCR (unos 10 segundos cada una); las de texto real son instantáneas.
backtrans: This PDF has {count} pages. Pages that are images are read with OCR (about 10 seconds each); real-text ones are instant.

english: Draw or type a new one
backtrans: Draw or type a new one

english: Check the pages (the document has {count} pages)
target: Revisa las páginas (el documento tiene {count} páginas)
backtrans: Check the pages (the document has {count} pages)

english: Couldn't find the page edges. Drag the corners.
target: No se encontraron los bordes. Arrastra las esquinas.
backtrans: The edges were not found. Drag the corners.

english: Enlarging doesn't add detail — the page may look soft.
target: Ampliar no añade detalle: la página puede verse borrosa.
backtrans: Enlarging does not add detail: the page may look blurry.

target: Igualar el color de la página automáticamente

english: Delete {count} pages? They are removed when you save.
backtrans: Delete {count} pages? They are removed on saving.

english: Could not get under {mb} MB; sent the smallest version.
target: No se pudo bajar de {mb} MB; se envió la versión más pequeña.
backtrans: Could not get below {mb} MB; the smallest version was sent.
